method_parameters.group_weight: Each nonempty group has total weight one before Huber weighting
method_parameters.motion_model: Fixed linear Jacobian, min-norm IRLS; Rodrigues rotation about original camera centre
method_parameters.frame_policy: Only frames accepted by the original target-normal quality checks may change

limitations: Previously inspected real scan: development evidence, not an untouched final test.
RoomPlan candidate boxes and unique ownership are priors, not semantic ground truth.
Scoring observations are disjoint from later-view estimation samples but share the same frames and sensor.
Neighbour/background nearest-training-plane residuals measure consistency, not physical accuracy.
Raw scan, camera records and derived observation bundles stay local because their source has no redistribution license.
Small rigid motion is constrained jointly by training surfaces, not identified by a single plane.
Full rank and a better residual do not identify the physical cause or establish a true camera pose.
Low-count per-frame controls remain unverified; a group aggregate does not replace their evidence.
